title: Canonical affine embedding of a quasi-affine scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] isomorphic to a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme (a quasi-affine scheme). Put $C=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and let $j:X\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] be the unique morphism corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_C$ under the bijection of [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme]. Then $X$ is quasi-compact and separated, hence quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $j$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion].
